Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 30-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE, MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Cloud Computing [CSE_4063]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                A mid-sized healthcare startup, MediLink, is developing an AI-based patient monitoring platform that (5)  
  collects real-time health data from wearable IoT devices. The company expects heavy data traffic  
  A)           during national health campaigns and needs to ensure:  
  
  High scalability to handle sudden data surges,  
  Strong data privacy and security to comply with healthcare regulations,  
  Low infrastructure maintenance due to limited in-house IT expertise, and  
  Occasional data sharing with government research institutions for collaborative projects.  
  
  As a Cloud Computing Consultant, recommend the most appropriate cloud deployment model  
  (Public, Private, Community, or Hybrid) for MediLink.  
  Apply the characteristics of the chosen model to justify your recommendation in relation to the  
  organization's requirements.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           A growing e-learning company, EduWave Solutions, offers online coding and data science courses          (5)  
  to thousands of learners across the world. Recently, the company has been facing challenges in:  
  
  Managing increasing user demand during live sessions,  
  Providing reliable access to course materials at any time and from any location,  
  Reducing the costs of maintaining physical servers, and  
  Ensuring that students can access the platform seamlessly even when new updates or  
  features are deployed.  
  
  As a Cloud Computing Consultant, identify and explain any three key characteristics or features of  
  Cloud Computing that EduWave Solutions can utilize to overcome the challenges mentioned in the  
  scenario.  
  Apply each feature to the situation clearly to justify its relevance.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                A startup plans to deploy multiple operating systems on limited hardware resources.                     (5)  
  a) Apply the concept of virtualization to suggest an efficient setup.  
  A)           b) Demonstrate how virtualization software manages multiple OS instances concurrently.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           A research lab wants to leverage virtualization for parallel data simulations requiring GPU             (5)  
  acceleration.  
  a) Explain how hardware-assisted virtualization and custom hardware improve simulation  
  Page #1

performance.  
  b) Propose a hardware-software configuration that supports both high throughput and flexibility.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)           A Bank is shifting its online banking system to a cloud environment using Service-Oriented             (5)  
  Architecture (SOA).  
  A)      a) Identify the two services that can be made reusable in this banking system.  
  b) Analyze how loose coupling helps when updating one of the services.  
  c) Recommend a standard protocol that can enable communication among these services.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)      A smart hospital system relies on a private UDDI registry to support Service-Oriented Architecture     (5)  
  (SOA). Critical services like Patient Records, Emergency Alerts, and Medical Device Monitoring  
  must be automatically discovered by hospital applications in real time.  
  a) Analyze how UDDI's core data structures enable accurate and fast discovery of these services  
  during emergencies.  
  b) Evaluate how Subscription and Replication APIs help maintain reliability and up-to-date service  
  access across multiple hospital branches.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)           A research institute currently uses a Grid computing system for scientific simulations but is planning (5)  
  to migrate to a Cloud platform to support new AI-based healthcare applications that require real-  
  A)      time processing and elastic scaling.  
  a) Analyze why the Grid system may struggle to meet the new AI application requirements,  
  considering features such as resource sharing, throughput, and scalability.  
  b) Recommend how Cloud computing features like on-demand self-service, virtualization, and rapid  
  elasticity would improve performance and resource management after migration.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)      A cloud platform automatically reallocates virtual machines when CPU usage exceeds 80%,                (5)  
  ensuring continuous performance without manual intervention. Explain how automated policy-  
  based SLA management is applied in this situation and discuss one advantage of using such  
  automation.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)           An organization regularly scans its cloud servers using automated tools to detect outdated             (5)  
  software, misconfigurations, and open ports that could be exploited by attackers. Apply your  
  A)      understanding of vulnerability assessment to explain how this process helps the organization  
  enhance and maintain the security of its cloud environment in this scenario.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)      An IT organization uses role-based access control (RBAC) in its cloud environment, where            (5)  
  employees can access only the data and applications relevant to their job roles.  
  Analyze how Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) enhances security in a cloud environment by  
  restricting access based on user roles. In the given scenario, explain how RBAC reduces the risk of  
  unauthorized access and supports secure access management.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
